title: [review] messaging.py:85: deliver() stores reference to
description: The public deliver() method appends the passed message dict directly to _inbox without making a copy. If external callers mutate the dict after calling deliver(), the inbox contents are silently corrupted. Compare to inbox() at line 98 which defensively copies, and the deepcopy at line 150 for _sent storage. Mesh message handlers that reuse/mutate message dicts would corrupt inbox state.
